scientific_limitation: Dataset spans 2010-07 to 2024-12 (174 usable months after 6-month lag window drop). Train covers 2010-07 to 2020-12 (126 months, 10 complete Indian monsoon seasons). Val covers 2021-01 to 2022-12 (24 months, 2 complete monsoon seasons). This tabular XGBoost baseline treats each (cell, month) pair independently — spatial neighborhood structure is not captured. ConvLSTM and CNN models (EXP-005, EXP-006) are the next steps to exploit spatial structure.
